scope: New Bybit demo read qualification slice only. Nautilus remains the sole ordinary order authority. No REST order submission, production route, or assisted authority is introduced.

public_interfaces.native_config: build_bybit_demo_config(identity, credential) constructs the pinned Nautilus rc5 BybitExecutionClientConfig; no connection is started
public_interfaces.receipt: BybitDemoReadReceipt exposes endpoint, receive time and raw/canonical hashes; canonical payload is repr-hidden
public_interfaces.snapshot: capture_bybit_account_snapshot(reader, expected_account_fingerprint=None) returns identity_hash, captured_at_ns, eligible, reasons, account_fingerprint, status, and hidden source receipts
public_interfaces.protection: verify_bybit_protection(position, symbol, expected_signed_qty, stop_price, now_ns, received_at_ns) checks exact Full/MarkPrice/positionIdx=0 readback

read_constraints.safe_receipts: SHA-256 payload hashes, endpoint allowlist and opaque identity hash

qualification_checks: optional expected account fingerprint matches the SHA-256 binding of the opaque account scope reference and API key hash; V5 Get Account Info does not return an account UID
complete read set remains within the 2-second evidence freshness bound
important_limit: The reader is a bounded evidence adapter, not a live recovery engine. Its account snapshot does not prove order-history completeness across an unbounded account history; venue retention windows and a bounded caller-selected time window must be integrated by the runtime before reconciliation can treat it as complete.
ordinary_order_effects: No ordinary REST order effect exists in this module. Parent runtime must dispatch all orders through the pinned Nautilus execution client and preserve durable UNKNOWN/lost-ack semantics.
ordinary_remaining: Root selected-demo factory integration and native Bybit node lifecycle wiring
Durable journal reconciliation mapping for Bybit order, fill, fee, funding and account receipts
ProtectionPort ensure_full_stop/economic-event adapter wiring to a durable intent/effect boundary
Independent runtime review and full offline end-to-end unknown/lost-ack gate
external_proof_remaining: Demo credential presence and permission review without exposing key material
Live DEMO account info, wallet, positions, order history, fills, closed PnL and funding read receipts
Observed exact Bybit unified-account status and isolated margin profile for the target account
Native Nautilus rc5 Bybit demo connection, event delivery and order-state reconciliation
Fill-time protection equivalence and exact Full MarkPrice stop readback against a demo position
External demo evidence must not be fabricated by offline fixtures
